transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to get the desk roster sorted for the command-post exercise starting Monday at 0600. We've got three desks to fill — movement control, communications log, and sustainment tracking — and three available personnel: PFC Ortiz, SPC Bell, and Sgt. Noor. Before I publish the final roster, I need to run through the standard pre-exercise process: qualification and availability readback from personnel, signal, and logistics staff. Who can speak to the qualifications and availability of our three candidates?
